title: Dual Coda Torxica
extract:
Dual Coda Torxica are unique Coda dual pistols that tags enemies to release  Cold spores upon their death, applying Damage Vulnerability.

Characteristics
This weapon primarily deals  Slash damage.
Enemies hit by Dual Coda Torxica and then killed from any source will spread spores to 3 enemies within 20 meters with the closest being prioritized, inflicting guaranteed  Cold status per second and 50% Damage Vulnerability lasting for 20 seconds.
Damage Vulnerability only applies to damage inflicted by the Dual Coda Torxica, not any other source.
Adversary Weapon:
Comes with an additional bonus  Impact,  Heat,  Cold,  Electricity,  Toxin,  Magnetic, or  Radiation damage, which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
Valence Fusion can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
Polarizing the weapon increases its max rank by 2, capping at rank 40 after 5 polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
 Elemental Vice can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
Unlike Kuva and Tenet weapons directly acquired from a Kuva Lich or Sisters of Parvos, the listed Mastery Rank requirement is enforced.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (25.00%)
High burst DPS (648)
Very high sustained DPS (595.93)
Very high magazine size (160)
Very high ammo pickup (60)
Very high accuracy (1.50° to 5.00°)
Very high ammo max (480)
Above average fire rate (6.00 attacks/sec)
High status chance (28.00%)
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average total damage (50)
Low reload speed (2.33 s)
Very low disposition (●○○○○ (0.55x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition

Dual Coda Torxica is purchased from Eleanor of  The Hex in the Höllvania Central Mall for 10  Live Heartcell obtained from vanquishing a Technocyte Coda. Each offering has a random progenitor bonus damage type and percentage increase, which is cycled every 4 days.

Notes
When an enemy is killed by the Dual Coda Torxica, they spread 3 spores to nearby enemies within 20 meters. Enemies affected by spores will suffer 50% Damage Vulnerability for 20 seconds, while also suffering from a guaranteed  Cold proc each second.
Spores will prioritize enemies closest to the target, and enemies can only suffer from 1 spore at a time.
Affected enemies will glow based on the location the spore hit them, which serves purely as a visual indicator and has no effect on damage received (unlike similar indicators from  Sonar or  Detect Vulnerability).
 Cold procs can build up over time, but as they use the standard 6-second Status Duration, which can be modified if the player desires, affected enemies can only suffer up to 6 Cold procs at a time before the earliest proc expires. The spores' duration cannot be changed.
Spores will only inflict  Cold procs, which deal no additional damage and cannot have additional status effects forced upon them via Abilities.
 Secondary Encumber is an exception to this, as spore procs can trigger this Arcane and, assuming a fully-ranked Arcane, generate one additional status effect on average.
The damage vulnerability behaves like a faction damage mod as it is applied twice to status effects. It is however a unique modifier and multiplicative to faction damage mods or other damage vulnerability sources.
The Dual Coda Torxica sports a unique reticle that changes when the player is aiming at a target affected by spores, gaining 3 asymmetrical growths.

Adversary Notes
For weapons obtained from vanquishing the Kuva Lich or Sister:
The player does not have to meet the Mastery Rank displayed to obtain this weapon. It can simply be claimed from the foundry after the Lich/Sister carrying it has been vanquished.
The weapon will have a prefix of the name of the Lich/Sister it was acquired from (e.g. a Kuva Kohm might be called "Odizrigg Agekk Kuva Kohm").
Refraining from Mercy killing an Adversary candidate and letting them die will remove their weapon from the pool of potential Adversary weapons until each has been refused, but only if the mission is completed. Weapons rejected from aborted missions will remain in the current cycle.
It is also possible for the weapon to be removed from the cycle even without waiting for the Adversary candidate to die before extracting from the mission.
For weapons obtained from Ergo Glast's and Eleanor's shop:
The player must meet the Mastery Rank displayed to obtain this weapon, as it is claimed from an NPC shop rather than the foundry.
The weapon's max rank caps at 40 after 5 polarizations (max rank increases by 2 per Forma added).
Additional polarizations can be added when the weapon reaches its new max rank at that polarization level.
Each additional rank also gives 100 Mastery Rank experience, giving 4,000 points in total at level 40.
Mod capacity scales with the additional ranks, and can reach a total of 80 at rank 40 with an Orokin Catalyst installed.
Without an Orokin Catalyst, the max is 40. Combined with the five polarized mod slots required to reach that point, an Orokin Catalyst might not be required for some beginner-friendly builds as they typically use less mod capacity.
After polarizing a weapon, any additional mod capacity above 30 (60 with an Orokin Catalyst) will not take effect until the weapon's rank reaches 31 and above.
Legendary Mastery Rank increases the minimum mod capacity for such weapons, without the weapon needing to be rank 31 and above. For example, Legendary 1 increases the minimum capacity to 31 (62 with an Orokin Catalyst).
Comes with an additional damage stat.
For Lich/Sister-obtained weapons this is dependent on the Warframe that summoned the Lich/Sister.
For Ergo Glast's and Eleanor's shops a random bonus stat will be offered for each weapon and changed every 4 days (96 hours).
This damage stat randomly ranges between 25%-60%. It can be upgraded up to its maximum value with Valence Fusion using another copy of the weapon.
The element of this bonus can be changed at will among the available Valence elements once an Elemental Vice is applied.
This bonus stat is considered a base damage type and will be applied after all elemental mods for the purposes of elemental combinations. It uses the weapon's falloff range but always scales linearly from 100% to 0%, regardless of what the weapon's falloff damage scaling is.

Tips

Trivia
On Devstream 184, the weapon was named Dual Coda Nicardia.
Instead of using the same prefix arrangement as other akimbo weapons like  Kuva Twin Stubbas and  Prisma Twin Gremlins with variant prefix (Kuva/Prisma/Coda) before akimbo prefix (Twin/Dual) as Coda Dual Torxica, Dual Coda Torxica goes the other way around with akimbo prefix before variant prefix.
The Dual Coda Torxica's reload, like all Coda weapons, has a unique animation. This one is designed around the Torxica's mutated handles, where the Warframe feeds the guns by tossing two small glowing sacks into it's mouths.
Torx (which the weapon might derive its name from) is a brand of screw drive characterized by a 6-point star-shaped pattern. This appears to be alluding to the weapons being Infested power drills.
